name: The Lisbon MBA Católica|Nova (Nova SBE and Católica Lisbon SBE)

program.notes: The Lisbon MBA International: joint degree of Nova SBE and Católica Lisbon, 12-month accelerated programme, 90 ECTS, includes a 1-month immersion at MIT Sloan. Ranked by the FT as one programme, so a single file covers both schools (no separate catolica-lisbon.json).

class_size.notes: Official NOVA programme catalogue gives 50 vacancies, not actual enrolment.

tuition_total.notes: Catalogue refers to https://thelisbonmba.com/admissions-fees-and-funding for details (that site is behind an anti-bot check). Third-party listings show 39,500 EUR (not used).

base_salary.notes: No employment report found. The school's news of 21 Feb 2025 cites FT 2025 figures: average annual gross salary USD 135,825 and +87% increase three years after graduation (FT alumni data, not a starting salary).

employment.notes: '97% employment rate within six months of graduation' from the school news of 21 Feb 2025 (cohort not stated, likely the FT 2025 survey class).

profile.notes: From the Nova SBE news of 21 Feb 2025 (FT 2025 context); minimum 3 years of experience required.

rankings_cited.notes: Excerpt of the FT 2026 table on ClearAdmit: 'The Lisbon MBA Catolica | Nova' 79 (tie), prior year 77.

notes: thelisbonmba.com (fees, careers, class profile) returns an anti-bot 'One moment, please...' page to curl and WebFetch.
